metadata.title: A correct baseline misses a specified latency, throughput, memory or cost objective.

applicability.scope: Optimization of a specified metric under fixed workload, quality and resource constraints.
applicability.input_contract: Actual hardware, model, engine, script and flags, benchmark, acceptance criteria, current diagnosis, permitted changes and budget.
applicability.produced_artifact: Paired baseline/candidate measurements, quality checks, trade-offs and final replay.
applicability.refusal_point: Record missing evidence or an exhausted search budget and identify the smallest discriminating test before declaring success.
